nodes.label: Phone-number OTP Authentication
nodes.rationale: Phone-number auth only — no email, no password. Simplifies identity for IoT customers and sharing by phone number.

nodes.label: Cloud/Local Dual MQTT
nodes.rationale: Each device has a local MQTT broker on LAN plus cloud MQTT when internet is available, enabling low-latency LAN control and cloud persistence.

nodes.label: Event Sourcing
nodes.rationale: Every state change (ON/OFF, online/offline) is recorded as an immutable event for audit history and replay.

nodes.label: Cloud/Local Hybrid Behavior
nodes.rationale: Device connects to both local and cloud MQTT when internet available. Local broker handles low-latency LAN commands; cloud backend persists state. Buffered events sync to cloud on reconnect.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication
nodes.rationale: JWT access + refresh tokens issued after phone OTP verification via SMS gateway.

nodes.label: RFC 7807 Error Responses
nodes.rationale: All API errors follow RFC 7807 problem details format for consistent client error handling.

nodes.label: Materialized State vs Event History
nodes.rationale: device_states is the current materialized view; device_events is the append-only full history. Events are never mutated after insert.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.rationale: deleted_at column on users, households, devices, share_permissions for logical deletion without losing referential history.
